sourceText: User approved adding a clear artifact provenance/version record for DONE stories whose CLI patch version does not bump, after B-fe25 showed a non-runtime experiment/protocol DONE merge with version bump skipped.
normalizedOutcome: Non-runtime DONE artifacts get a queryable artifact release provenance record while CLI package semver remains reserved for runtime/capability inputs.
acceptanceClaim: A DONE merge that changes experiments/** records an artifact release with story id, main commit, releasable paths, and artifactSetDigest; artifact_release_list/status can inspect it; version-bump-smoke still proves experiments/** do not trigger CLI semver.
